0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets, 0-4 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Detroit Pistons, who are 4-1 and first in the East and the Central after winning their last game. Brooklyn is 0-2 at home and sits 5th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, while Detroit has won four of its last five. Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) are out for the Nets, and Noah Clowney (illness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. For Detroit, Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) is out, and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while the Nets lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 138-100 defeat in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
